title: Credit Rating Purchases and S&P 500 Index Membership Decisions
authors: Kun Li; Xin Liu; Shang-Jin Wei
eligible_reason: No staggered binary DiD. Table 4 regresses S&P 500 addition (spadd_scaled) on time-varying rating-purchase indicators (purany2_1, sppur1, mpur) with firm characteristics as controls and gvkey/cyq FE (rating purchase is a non-absorbing regressor, outcome is index entry). Tables 5-6 regress rating purchases on index-opening measures (inter_top1000, size-group dummies) with group-window FE. Table 7 uses the 2002 S&P rule change excluding non-US firms: postnonus_sp/_mu, a single common date, with controls in some columns. No unit-specific adoption dates.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe; firm-quarter panel 1980-2018 (non-S&P 500 firms and new additions, 479,101 obs) and window-level stacked comparisons of S&P vs Moody's purchases (absorb(gw cw), cluster(gw cw obsn)). Table 8 is an event-window means comparison around addition/announcement dates.
data_files_note: ReadMe.docx: data from Siblis Research, Capital IQ S&P ratings, Moody's Rating Delivery Services, Compustat/CRSP, Capital IQ ownership, SDC cannot be redistributed. Package ships do files, logs and a data dictionary only.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Not a staggered adoption design; data not shipped.
